description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tokens (in thousands) associated with different categories of data used in the training of large language models for the Sámi language. The vertical axis represents the number of tokens, labeled as "Tokens (K)," and the horizontal axis lists the categories. The categories include Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, and Blogs. The News category has the highest number of tokens at 10,584, followed by Administrative at 6,472, Religion at 6,052, Non-fiction at 1,889, Fiction at 387, Law at 354, and Blogs at 32. The bars are colored in sky blue, and the values are annotated above each bar. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars, and there is no legend or additional information provided.
